Welcome to the United States of America🇺🇸 Just 1 week until America’s 250th Birthday! 🎉✨ From spectacular fireworks and patriotic celebrations to parades, concerts, festivals and special events across the country, it’s one of the most exciting times to visit the USA❤️🤍💙 Now step into New York City 🗽✨ The city that never sleeps, where iconic landmarks, incredible architecture and unforgettable energy come together around every corner 📍 10 Must-Visit Locations in NYC 1️⃣ Statue of Liberty 🗽 The ultimate symbol of freedom and one of America’s most famous landmarks 2️⃣ Central Park 🌳 Escape the city’s hustle with beautiful paths, lakes, and iconic views 3️⃣ Times Square ✨ Bright lights, giant billboards and nonstop energy day and night 4️⃣ Brooklyn Bridge 🌉 Walk across for breathtaking skyline views and unforgettable photos 5️⃣ Empire State Building 🏙️ Experience one of the best panoramic views of New York City 6️⃣ Grand Central Terminal 🚆 A historic masterpiece with one of the world’s most beautiful train halls 7️⃣ The High Line 🌿 An elevated park filled with gardens, art and amazing city views 8️⃣ Rockefeller Center 🏙️ Home to the famous observation deck and iconic NYC
